mcqs.question: Under the proposal for an Indian Scientific Service, scientists are presently governed by which rules?
mcqs.explanation: Scientists are presently governed by the Central Civil Services (Conduct) Rules, 1964. The Official Secrets Act, 1923 concerns official secrecy, while the NCW Act and Electoral Trust Scheme relate to different subjects.

mcqs.question: Which one of the following statements regarding the proposed Indian Scientific Service is incorrect?
options: It envisages national recruitment with peer evaluation.
It would embed scientists in ministries and regulators.
It would operate through separate service rules.
It would recruit scientists only through state-level examinations.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement is that recruitment would be only through state-level examinations. The proposal envisages national recruitment with peer evaluation, along with scientists embedded in ministries and regulators and separate service rules.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is an illustrative cadre proposed under the Indian Scientific Service?
mcqs.explanation: Environmental & Ecological is one of the illustrative cadres proposed for the Indian Scientific Service. Parliamentary privileges, electoral trust administration and constitutional litigation are not listed as illustrative cadres.

mcqs.question: The proposed Indian Scientific Service draws illustrative models from which group of countries?
options: US, UK, France, Germany and Japan
US, UK, Canada, Australia and Japan
France, Germany, Italy, Russia and Japan
UK, France, Australia, Germany and Israel
mcqs.explanation: The proposed models are from the US, UK, France, Germany and Japan. The other options replace one or more of these countries with countries not included in the stated group.

mcqs.question: The Election Commission of India is established under which Article and from which year?
mcqs.explanation: The Election Commission of India is established under Article 324 and dates from 1950. The alternatives alter either the constitutional Article or the year of establishment.

mcqs.question:
Match the Parliamentary Friendship Groups with their respective chairs.

List-I
(a) Russia
(b) Australia
(c) Italy
(d) Germany

List-II
i. P. Chidambaram
ii. Sanjay Jha
iii. Nishikant Dubey
iv. Akhilesh Yadav
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are Russia–Nishikant Dubey, Australia–Akhilesh Yadav, Italy–P. Chidambaram and Germany–Sanjay Jha. The other codes interchange the chairs among these country groups.

mcqs.question: Who chairs the Parliamentary Friendship Group associated with the Baltic countries—Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania?
mcqs.explanation: P.V. Mithun Reddy chairs the Parliamentary Friendship Group associated with the Baltic countries. Anurag Thakur chairs the EU Parliament group, while Sanjay Jha and Nishikant Dubey chair the Germany and Russia groups respectively.

mcqs.question: Who is the chair of the Parliamentary Friendship Group associated with the EU Parliament?
mcqs.explanation: Anurag Thakur is the chair of the Parliamentary Friendship Group associated with the EU Parliament. P.V. Mithun Reddy, Akhilesh Yadav and P. Chidambaram are associated with the Baltic, Australia and Italy groups respectively.

mcqs.question:
How many of the following statements regarding electoral trust donations in 2024–25 are correct?

1. Electoral trusts received ₹3,826.35 crore in total.
2. The BJP received ₹3,157.66 crore.
3. The INC received ₹298 crore.
4. The AITC received ₹120 crore.
mcqs.explanation: Exactly three statements are correct: the total was ₹3,826.35 crore, the BJP received ₹3,157.66 crore, and the INC received ₹298 crore. The AITC received ₹102 crore, not ₹120 crore.

mcqs.question: According to the ADR data for 2024–25, how many companies contributed more than ₹3,636 crore to electoral trusts?
mcqs.explanation: A total of 228 companies contributed more than ₹3,636 crore to electoral trusts. The figure of 99 refers to individuals, while ₹187 crore refers to the amount contributed by individuals.

mcqs.question: When was the Electoral Trust Scheme launched?
mcqs.explanation: The Electoral Trust Scheme was launched in 2013. The year 2024–25 refers to the donation data period, while 1990 and 2004 relate to other institutional facts.
